notes.title: Working on the Multiplayer Part of the Game
notes.notes:
Hey Guys,

first thing i would to say is Thank you for the Support!

Also thank you for our Testers! With you we can make this Game even better an better.

Well...

Actually i work on the Multiplayer part for the game. I created a Test Map, like a Arena, where you can Join or Host and play with Friends.
On this Map you can spawn later Enemys and fight with your Friends against Undeads.

This Map is to test the Multiplayer Connections, Chats, Gameplay, AI ...... and so on!

In the next Update there is the Map with Multiplayer, without Spawning Objects or Enemys!

:) I Hope you enjoy it :)
